title: 心理情報プログラミングⅡ
subtitle: Programing in Psychology and Information Design II
educationalGoal: Recent research in psychology tends to yield increasingly large datasets obtained through experiments and surveys. As data sizes grow, spreadsheet software becomes inadequate for reviewing the entire dataset or performing the necessary preprocessing for analysis, necessitating the use of statistical software. This course aims to equip students with data handling techniques - such as data verification and preprocessing - required after data acquisition, using command-line interface (CUI) statistical software.
advice: The contents of this course will be used in the “Psychological Informatics Major Lab/Exercises B” course, which is a compulsory course offered the following year.
books: Reference books: RユーザのためのRStudio[実践]入門,Data visualization
requiredKnowledge: Basic computer skills. Basic programing skills. Students should bring their own PC to every class.

activityGoals.body: Ability to write R programs tailored to specific analytical objectives.
Ability to preprocess and format collected data into a form suitable for analysis in R.
Ability to perform data visualization in R in accordance with analytical objectives.
Ability to identify outliers in collected data using R.
Ability to optimize R code related to data handling tasks.
